lines.show: The OKX referral program lets existing users invite friends with a personal code, and the program terms in the app decide what each side may receive.
Sharing is simple. Sharing it well takes a bit of care.
Here's how to find your code, share it, and stay on the right side of the rules.
First, find your code.
Open the OKX app and log in.
Go to the main menu or your profile.
Open the section called Invite or Referral. The exact name can change between versions.
Copy your code from there.

scenes.title: Read the program terms
scenes.text: They decide what each side receives.

lines.show: Before you share, read the referral program terms on that page.
They explain what inviters and new users may receive, and they can change.
Good sharing is simple.
Send the code itself, not a mystery link.
Tell your friend to type it in the referral field at sign-up.
And point them to the official app store listing.
Never promise people a fixed amount of money for signing up.
Platforms like TikTok and YouTube remove posts like that, and the terms may not match your promise.
If a friend needs help, walk them through the steps.
Never ask for their password or verification codes.
After a friend signs up with your code, the referral page in the app usually shows the invite.
That's the place to check, rather than guessing.
Also remember that OKX isn't available in every country.
Only invite people where it serves users.
